abstract: BACKGROUND: Gross genetic causes for SCT are unknown; however, it might be associated with other abnormalities. We assessed the incidence of associated abnormalities in a large national cohort of neonates with SCT and aimed to identify predictive risk factors. PROCEDURE: The medical records were reviewed of 235 consecutive neonates with SCT treated at the six pediatric surgical centers in the Netherlands from 1970 to 2010. Potential risk factors for associated abnormalities analyzed included sex, gestational age, tumor-volume/histology and Altman-classification. RESULTS: In 76 patients (32.3%) at least one associated abnormality was diagnosed, with hydronephrosis as the most common (16.2%) and hip dysplasia in 4.3%. Multiple abnormalities were documented for 21 (9.0%). Prematurity and Altman type IV SCT were associated with an increased risk of any associated abnormality. No association between increased tumor-volume and hydronephrosis or hip dysplasia was found. Patients with type IV Altman SCT had a fourfold risk of suffering from hydronephrosis compared to Altman type I SCT. CONCLUSIONS: SCT was associated with other abnormalities in one-third of children. Some were tumor-related while others were related to prematurity or occurred sporadically. In contrast to clinically obvious anomalies, hip dysplasia or hydronephrosis might be latently present with more subtle clinical presentation. We therefore suggest renal- and hip-ultrasound in all patients, certainly those with Altman type IV SCT. LEVEL OF EVIDENCE RATING: Level II (retrospective study).
abstract_ja: 背景：仙尾部奇形腫(SCT)の明確な遺伝的原因は不明であるが、他の奇形を伴う可能性がある。本研究では、SCTを有する新生児の大規模な全国コホートにおける合併奇形の頻度を評価し、予測的危険因子の同定を目的とした。手順：1970年から2010年までにオランダの6つの小児外科施設で治療を受けた連続235例のSCT新生児の診療記録を後方視的に調べた。合併奇形の潜在的危険因子として、性別、在胎週数、腫瘍体積／組織型、Altman分類を解析した。結果：76例(32.3%)に少なくとも1つの合併奇形が診断され、水腎症が最も多く(16.2%)、股関節形成不全は4.3%であった。21例(9.0%)では複数の奇形が認められた。早産およびAltman IV型SCTは、いずれの合併奇形のリスク上昇とも関連した。腫瘍体積の増加と水腎症または股関節形成不全との間に関連は認められなかった。Altman IV型SCTの患者は、Altman I型SCTの患者と比べて水腎症のリスクが4倍であった。結論：SCTは小児の3分の1で他の奇形と関連していた。一部は腫瘍関連であり、他は早産に関連するか、散発的に生じたものであった。臨床的に明らかな奇形とは異なり、股関節形成不全や水腎症は、より微細な臨床経過で潜在的に存在しうる。したがって、特にAltman IV型SCTの患者を含む全患者に対して腎および股関節の超音波検査を行うことを提案する。エビデンスレベル：レベルII(後方視的研究)。
